text:
incident-bot: PAGED @jamie (oncall) — ingress gateway 5xx spike detected for /v1/generate across us-west-2. 5xx rate = 18% over 2m. Rolling error trend. correlation sample: trace=trc-6f3b9a

jamie (oncall): seeing it, joining :wave:

sasha (sre): I'm looking at the gateway logs. Early signal looks like repeated upstream 502s from runtime pool A. Possible retry amplification.

mina (prod): customer-impact: initial alert list shows ~14 customers with elevated error rates (mostly low-latency endpoints). I'll open a ticket for CS to notify affected accounts if it persists.

jamie (oncall): quick mitigation — can we disable retries at the gateway for the affected route? That should stop amplification. If someone can push a config patch to staging then prod, I'll flip traffic to fallback region if needed.

leah (eng): I can patch gateway retry config. Proposed change: set max_retries=0 for route /v1/generate and lower timeout to 6s. Will push canary to 5% first.

sasha (sre): timeline so far:
- 1978012345 incident-bot alert: 5xx spike
- +40s: first oncall ack (jamie)
- +2m: gateway error rate peaked at 24%
- +3m: initial hypothesis: upstream runtime returning 502s; gateway retries causing amplification

carlos (support): a customer reported stuck requests around 15:03 PST with correlation id corr=b1c4f2a7. They saw retry loops in client logs.

jamie (oncall): can someone paste a minimal sample of the gateway error lines and an upstream runtime error? need correlation ids.

leah (eng): pasting logs (truncated):
```
2026-03-15T15:02:21Z gw-01 ERROR route=/v1/generate status=502 upstream=runtime-a-07 trace=trc-6f3b9a cid=b1c4f2a7 msg="upstream response 502: malformed response"
2026-03-15T15:02:21Z gw-01 INFO retry attempt=1 route=/v1/generate cid=b1c4f2a7
2026-03-15T15:02:22Z gw-01 INFO retry attempt=2 route=/v1/generate cid=b1c4f2a7
2026-03-15T15:02:23Z runtime-a-07 ERROR request_id=req-9d2 upstream_error=segfault trace=trc-6f3b9a
```

mina (prod): adding more context: runtime-a-07 shows increased memory pressure just before the segfault. I see OOM-like messages in the container runtime logs. Link: https://s3.redwood.internal/logs/runtime-a-07/1978012345.log

ops-bot: Auto-collecting traces for trace=trc-6f3b9a, collecting full request logs (this may take ~30s) :gear:

sasha (sre): Hypotheses to track:
- H1 (upstream instability): runtime instance OOM/segfault -> 502 returned -> gateway retries amplify error rate
- H2 (gateway bug): incorrect handling of certain 502 payloads leading to retry loop (less likely given runtime error lines)
- H3 (network transient): transient network partition between gateway and runtime pool A causing repeated TCP resets

jamie (oncall): mitigation in progress: leah deployed retry-disable canary 5% at +4m. Monitoring error rate. If metrics drop, roll to 100% and keep disabled until runtime pool stabilized.

leah (eng): canary applied. Command used:
```bash
gwctl route update --route "/v1/generate" --max-retries 0 --timeout 6s --canary 5%
```

sasha (sre): Observed immediate effect on canary slice: 5xx rate for 5% dropped from 22% -> 1.8% (false positives from client cancellation). Full traffic still at 20% on primary.

mina (prod): starting capacity recovery for runtime pool A: scaling +3 instances and restarting unhealthy pods. Initiating graceful drain for runtime-a-07.

leah (eng): restarting runtime-a-07 now. Will report back when it comes up.

carlos (support): forwarding affected customer snippets to jamie: customer corr=b1c4f2a7, client stack shows exponential backoff absent jitter — they hit multiple retries quickly which increased load. I'll advise them to add jitter.

ops-bot: runtime-a-07 restarted at 15:06:12Z, healthcheck passed at 15:06:45Z.

sasha (sre): metrics update +6m: overall 5xx rate fell to 9% after restarts and canary. Still above baseline (~0.5%).

jamie (oncall): rolling the retry-disable to 100% now. If we see latency increase we can revert.

leah (eng): rolling to 100%...

leah (eng): rolled. Command: 
```bash
gwctl route update --route "/v1/generate" --max-retries 0 --timeout 6s --canary 100%
```

sasha (sre): post-rollback metrics: 5xx at 1.1% and error budget safe. Correlation with traces shows many of the previous 502s originated from runtime-a instances that hit OOMs. H1 gains weight.

mina (prod): customer-impact review: 14 affected tenants but most saw degraded success rates for short windows (1-4 mins). No major revenue-impacting customers flagged yet, CS notified.

jamie (oncall): next steps for RCA thread:
- collect full runtime logs for pool A (S3 links attached)
- compile timeline of instance lifecycle & mem pressure (kube events)
- create eval to replay request shapes to see memory blowup
- follow up on gateway retry policy to add jitter + safeguard counters

leah (eng): I'll take the runtime log collection and create a small replay harness. Attaching the log bundle: https://s3.redwood.internal/incident/1978012345/runtime-pool-a.tar.gz

ops-bot: Collected traces for trc-6f3b9a: https://traces.redwood.internal/traces/trc-6f3b9a

sasha (sre): assigning tasks: leah -> replay + logs, mina -> CS/customer impact summary, jamie -> postmortem owner and follow-up on retry policy, sasha -> correlate metrics + host-level OOMs.

carlos (support): will draft the customer note if PM/CS want a template.

jamie (oncall): Incident resolved to mitigated at 15:12:30Z. Creating a short incident ticket and linking this thread. Will start RCA doc with the hypotheses and attach logs. Thanks everyone. :tada:

sasha (sre): agreed — initial finding: runtime OOMs were primary cause; gateway retry amplification amplified customer-visible errors. We'll list mitigation: restart/recover runtime pool, disable retries for the route, add retry jitter and circuit-breaker thresholds.

mina (prod): filing internal ticket: INC-2026-0432, linking logs and this thread.

jamie (oncall): closing live coordination. I'll ping when the RCA doc draft is ready for review.

leah (eng): ETA for replay results ~3 business days.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0432 created and assigned to jamie (owner).
